title: Homework: Check a Module's Documentation
objective: Check each documented claim about a module against its behavior, mark the claims the code does not support, and correct the documentation without changing the code.
expected:
claim "parcels up to 5000 grams cost 500 cents": supported
claim "parcels of exactly 5000 grams cost 500 cents": supported
claim "parcels over 10000 grams cost 1200 cents": supported
claim "member prices are 10 percent off, rounded down to the cent": supported
claim "negative weights throw an error": supported
